_extraction_flags.notes: EXCLUDE: Power-over-Fiber (PoF) + Communication, but NO SENSING. Same pattern as O_ISAC_010. Power Grid infrastructure paper.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: SSMF-based PoF system with WDM. Fig.3: Optical PTE vs power. Fig.4: Electrical conversion. NO sensing diagrams.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Power-over-Fiber for Power Grid applications. 10W optical power + 155 Mbps data over 1 km SSMF. This is NOT an ISAC paper! The affiliation mentions 'Key Laboratory of Photonic Technology for Integrated Sensing and Communication' but the paper implements power + communication only. NO sensing functionality.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 155 Mbps via SFP module at 1310 nm. Power: 10W HPLD at 1064 nm, 49% optical PTE, 500 mW electrical output. NO sensing metrics.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: EXCLUSION RECOMMENDED: Same pattern as O_ISAC_010. Power + Communication co-transmission without sensing. Not relevant to O-ISAC survey scope.

bibliographic.title: Experimental Demonstration of Power over Fiber for Power Grid Application
bibliographic.authors: Zemian Zeng, Changna Chen, Xiaosheng Lin, Wei Chen, Jianping Li, Yuwen Qin

application.scenario_description: Power Grid infrastructure monitoring with simultaneous optical power and data transmission.

key_contribution.key_contribution: SSMF-based PoF demonstration with commercial SFP modules for Power Grid applications.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Lack of practical PoF implementations using SSMF for Power Grid scenarios.

transmitter.notes: HPLD at 1064 nm (10W, 40 GHz linewidth) for power. SFP at 1310 nm for data (155 Mbps).

receiver.notes: PPC (YCH-H003) for power conversion. SFP receiver for data.

integration.notes: WDM: 1064 nm power + 1310 nm data. NO sensing integration.

waveform.notes: Commercial SFP module (155 Mbps). No sensing waveform.

channel_wireless.notes: 1 km SSMF (9 µm core). WDM insertion loss ~2 dB. Total loss ~3 dB.

comm_metrics.notes: 155 Mbps via commercial SFP at 1310 nm. Stable transmission verified.

sensing_metrics.notes: NO SENSING FUNCTIONALITY IN THIS PAPER.

power_delivery.notes: 10W HPLD input, 4.9W collected (49% optical PTE). ~500 mW electrical after PPC (10% efficiency).

tradeoff.notes: Trade-off is power vs comm (not sensing vs comm). WDM separates wavelengths.
